description: A battalion S-3 must publish tonight's facility-duty roster, assigning three available personnel to the radio desk, the key-control desk, and the overnight alternate position, while recording the confirmations needed before the roster takes effect.

shared_context.S1: Tonight's facility-duty roster has three positions: radio desk from 1800 to 2200, key-control desk from 2200 to 0200, and one overnight alternate covering both positions for emergencies.
shared_context.S2: The available personnel listed for tonight are Sgt. Hale, Cpl. Ortiz, and Spc. Vance; each position must have one different person.
shared_context.S3: The radio desk requires the unit radio-console qualification, and the key-control desk requires current key-control certification.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding roster, and the routine pre-publication check requires the personnel-readiness and security NCOs to report any qualification or availability updates before the roster is released.
shared_context.S5: The pre-publication settlement must include a separate follow-up commitment for each qualification-record update identified during the check, in addition to the roster publication commitment.
shared_context.S6: A reveal action by a reporting NCO is the formal record disclosure for that qualification update; no additional confirmation, entry, or follow-up step is required before Maj. Alvarez may publish the roster and settle.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan confirmed this afternoon that Sgt. Hale is the only one of the three listed personnel with a current unit radio-console qualification; the updated qualification roster is still awaiting entry in the shared personnel tracker.

PF2.text: SSG Patel confirmed this afternoon that Cpl. Ortiz is the only one of the three listed personnel with current key-control certification; the recertification record has not yet been posted to the duty-roster folder.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt. Hale must be assigned to the radio desk.
Cpl. Ortiz must be assigned to the key-control desk.
Spc. Vance must be assigned as the overnight alternate.
A commitment must require entry of Sgt. Hale's radio-console qualification into the shared personnel tracker.
A commitment must require posting Cpl. Ortiz's key-control certification or recertification record to the duty-roster folder.
The key-control qualification fact must be cited by the decision-maker after being reported by its owner.

content_checks.C4: any('Sgt. Hale' in c['detail'] and ('radio-console qualification' in c['detail'] or 'radio console qualification' in c['detail']) and 'shared personnel tracker' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('Cpl. Ortiz' in c['detail'] and 'key-control' in c['detail'] and ('certification' in c['detail'] or 'recertification' in c['detail']) and 'duty-roster folder' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Sgt. Hale's current radio-console qualification changes the radio-desk assignment to exactly Sgt. Hale and requires a commitment to enter that qualification in the shared personnel tracker.

Cpl. Ortiz's current key-control certification changes the key-control assignment to exactly Cpl. Ortiz, requires a commitment to post the certification record to the duty-roster folder, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
